headline: AI memory shortage pushes 7-year-old Nvidia Shield TV price up $100
summary: The Nvidia Shield TV Pro, launched in 2019, now retails for $299.99, roughly a 50% increase. Coverage attributes the price hike to an AI-driven shortage of memory components, which has pushed up prices across devices that use it.

claims.statement: The Nvidia Shield TV Pro's price rose by about $100, to $299.99.
